overview: You counted from this Sunday to St Stephen and wrote one line in the almanac. Richmond is twenty-six days off. You did not add a time, a play, or a sum, and you did not mark this morning with anything but the feast.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Counted, and wrote the line once.

assets.name: the penny almanac
assets.disposition: Wrote twenty-six days against St Stephen

summary: Wrote twenty-six days against St Stephen
